segments.name: Bomie
segments.description: Reportable segment named Bomie, part of the company's TikTok e-commerce and e-commerce solutions business.
segments.evidence: In accordance with ASC 280, the Company has two operating and reportable segments, Bomie and Wookoo.

segments.name: Wookoo
segments.description: Reportable segment named Wookoo, part of the company's TikTok e-commerce and e-commerce solutions business.
segments.evidence: In accordance with ASC 280, the Company has two operating and reportable segments, Bomie and Wookoo.

revenueModel.text: Customers buy through the company's TikTok e-commerce business and pay for e-commerce solutions the company provides to them.
revenueModel.evidence: We conduct our business mainly through BW and its subsidiaries, engaging in e-commerce business on TikTok as well as providing e-commerce solutions to customers.

changes.text: In 2023 the Board suspended the company's e-commerce and internet information and advertising business.
changes.evidence: On September 3, 2023, the Board of Directors of the Company approved suspension of the Company's e-commerce and internet information and advertising business conducted through the Company's indirect subsidiary Happy Buy (Fujian) Internet Technology Co., Limited.

changes.text: In 2025 the company closed its acquisition of a majority stake in Bomie Wookoo LLC, which became its main operating business.
changes.evidence: The transaction was closed on March 25, 2025, upon the satisfaction or waiver of customary closing conditions, including the approval of the Company's shareholders.
